title: With great context comes great autonomy: leveling up your agent context
description:
Why AI agents need governed context, not just more data: Fivetran Context Layer and Agents Schema explained by dbt Labs and Fivetran at dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Ben Moser (dbt Labs) and Kevin Kim (Fivetran) explain why the hardest part of building a trustworthy AI agent is the context it needs before it can act. They show how Agents Schema writes what an agent learns about your business into open warehouse tables that any AI client can query over MCP, and how Fivetran Context Layer connects knowledge, operational, and analytics sources into one ontology.

In this session you'll learn:
• What context is and why a spectrum from semantic to situational context beats trying to load everything at once
• How Agents Schema and Fivetran Context Layer link a revenue table and a revenue doc into one governed view
• How traces show where an agent's confidence was low or context was missing

Speakers: Ben Moser, dbt platform team, dbt Labs; Kevin Kim, product manager, Fivetran

Learn more about Fivetran Context Layer: https://www.fivetran.com/context-layer
